title: Rodney’s REEL Outdoors

services.name: Bass Fishing
services.desc: At Rodney’s REEL Outdoors, we pride ourselves in friendly professional service and our ability to catch fish most of the time. We set our standards high, paying attention to all details because we want you to experience the best in nature and sport fishing. Join us for one of our guided fishing charters in the Okanagan. Fishing charter on scenic Okanagan, Wood, Kalamalka, Shuswap, and Skaha lakes to name a few, in the comfort of our 22-24 foot Thunderjet Boats. Our method of fishing is mostly trolling and the target species are Rainbow Trout, Lake Trout, and Kokanee. We can accommodate up to 7 anglers. Suited to anglers of all ages.
